rv.q: But the piece doesn’t shy away from its deeper themes of grief and loss, and Dada finds an elegantly moving parallel between the shortness of our time on earth and the fleeting, temporary nature of graffiti.
Dizzy is an entertaining and hugely positive reflection on grief.

cn.t: An intelligent, moving exploration of grief for young audiences that impresses with its crafted articulation of a difficult subject, though the ambitious execution doesn't fully land for all critics.
